en: Hey, we got two more warp spots{SAUT}over here. Which do we take?
I got it! It's the one to the left!
You seem certain, Panther.{SAUT}Did you figure out the hint?

Nope! I've just got a hunch, that's all.{PAGE}Actually, I just remembered I saw{SAUT}on TV that Scorpio was the most{SAUT}lucky sign for today.{PAGE}And Scorpio's lucky color was blue.{SAUT}So the blue warp spot is definitely{SAUT}the way to go!
Um... or not.{PAGE}Eheheh... I guess that's kinda flimsy.
Which one do you think is right,{SAUT}Aragaki-kun?
Huh? How the hell should I know?
Haha... No reason in particular.{PAGE}Joker makes the final call anyway.{SAUT}I suppose I just wanted your{SAUT}opinion for reference.
......{PAGE}No idea.{PAGE}For all we know, both of 'em{SAUT}are wrong.
Hahaha, true enough...{PAGE}If we do get this wrong, I hope we{SAUT}get a chance to go back and make{SAUT}the right choice.
